title: [BUG] There was another service outage. I have no idea what kind of compensation, apology, or improvement you are making.
body: You’re selling $100 and $200 plans, but the service doesn’t work. There’s no apology, no notice about the cause of the outage, nothing. You sell business plans and then treat customers like beta testers. If that’s what you’re going to do, you shouldn’t have sold these plans in the first place. I wonder if you’ve ever considered proper compensation for the business disruptions customers face when your service is down. It’s so frustrating that trashy startups like this keep popping up. Do you think people paying $100 or $200 subscriptions are using a free plan or something? If you can’t make the numbers work, any losses are because you failed to plan your business properly—it’s not our job to shoulder the damage when there’s an outage. You’re literally a garbage company selling garbage for money. I had a service to deploy today and you completely ruined it. That’s it—thanks, Anthropic. You have no respect for users who trusted you and paid money, so I can’t understand how you think you can run an AI business. Do you think “business” means just running things sloppily without even an apology when your servers go down? Even a school club wouldn’t operate a service like this I really hope you disappear from the market. ``` bash ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 2/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 2 seconds… (attempt 3/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 5 seconds… (attempt 4/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 10 seconds… (attempt 5/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 16 seconds… (attempt 6/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 35 seconds… (attempt 7/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 33 seconds… (attempt 8/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 32 seconds… (attempt 9/10) ⎿ API Error (529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}}) · Retrying in 35 seconds… (attempt 10/10) ⎿  API Error: 529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"Overloaded"}} ```

top_comments.author: domdomegg
top_comments.body:
Hey there, 529 errors are errors from our backend when there is more demand for Claude than our servers can currently handle. These errors are usually temporary and we're working hard to reduce their frequency. Sincere apologies that you have hit them, and I can assure we're doing all we can to increase capacity here!

As someone who also hits them sometimes I can relate with how frustrating this is. Always seems to happen at the most inopportune times for me! 😄

As this is a broader API proble

top_comments.body: Yes, I generally agree, but we should still be a bit more lenient？

top_comments.author: PuristCoder
top_comments.body: With the internet having developed to this point, there are countless ways to ensure service stability. Yet, they've experienced multiple outages without offering any apologies, compensation, or fixes. I think they don't deserve our leniency.
